entities.summary: Henri-Léon Greber was a French sculptor, and medallist. His son was the architect Jacques Gréber. Active in the United States, he produced a fountain sculpture of four equestrian statues for Harbor Hill in 1910, and the copy of The Kiss in the Philadelphia Rodin Museum.

entities.summary: Henri-Léon Greber was a French sculptor, and medallist. His son was the architect Jacques Gréber. Active in the United States, he produced a fountain sculpture of four equestrian statues for Harbor Hill in 1910, and the copy of The Kiss in the Philadelphia Rodin Museum.
